```java
hostRoleCommandCache.invalidateAll(taskIds);
```
```java
hostRoleCommandDAO.mergeAll(tasks);
```
```java

Reason:
The improper cache invalidation logic occurs because the cache is invalidated before the tasks are updated in the database. This leads to stale or incorrect cache entries being used during the upgrade process, causing the Express Upgrade to get stuck at a manual prompt.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
List<HostRoleCommandEntity> tasks = hostRoleCommandDAO.findByPKs(taskIds);
```
```java
hostRoleCommandDAO.mergeAll(tasks);
```
```java
hostRoleCommandCache.invalidateAll(taskIds);
```
Reason:
The fix involves ensuring that the tasks are first retrieved and updated in the database before invalidating the cache. This ensures that the cache reflects the most current state of the tasks, preventing stale data from causing the upgrade process to hang.
